provenance.notes: A new repository was initialized and only the recorded pre-fix SHA was fetched. The supplied patch applied cleanly. A non-mutating comparison against the local frozen Solver commit object confirmed that the independently reconstructed tree exactly equals the tree for the revision recorded in result.json. No accepted fix, post-fix upstream source, issue timeline, or audit data was inspected.

acceptanceCriteria.details: For prompt and confirm, an explicitly empty suffix adds no character. Default ': ' and custom non-empty suffix behavior remain unchanged. Both yes and no confirmation inputs were verified.

tests.details: Focused suffix matrix: 6 passed, 168 deselected. Full practical suite: 1,308 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed.

regressions.details: Independent probes covered empty/default/custom suffixes, prompt and confirm, yes/no confirmation, a hidden-input prompt, and the retry path after invalid confirmation input. Full suite passed.

explainability.details: The formatted prompt already contains prompt_suffix. The extra argument passed to the input function is Click's readline workaround space; suppressing only that extra space when prompt_suffix is exactly empty directly explains the fix while retaining the workaround otherwise.

prReadiness.details: The implementation is localized to the two input sites, includes symmetric prompt/confirm coverage, applies cleanly, exactly matches the frozen tree, and passes functional, build, lint, format, MyPy, compilation, and whitespace checks.

build.details: uv sync --frozen succeeded. uv build produced both click-8.3.dev0 source and wheel distributions. Python compileall passed for src and tests.

lint.details: Repository-wide Ruff check and Ruff format --check passed. git diff --check passed.

typecheck.details: Configured strict MyPy passed with no issues in 26 source files. Current Pyright reports 16 errors and 2 warnings identically on pristine and patched trees, so the patch introduces no Pyright regression.

limitations: Python 3.12.14 on Linux only; the full interpreter and Windows matrices were not run.
Current Pyright has 16 errors and 2 warnings on both pristine and patched trees; configured MyPy is clean.
